title: 第15章 牛爷我也悟了第16章 化名鬼谷
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
范蠡嘴角抽了抽，心道：这老头果然在放屁。饿了吃饭不饿，困了睡觉不困，这不是废话吗？三岁孩童都知道的道理，也值得拿出来说？
他正要开口反驳，却见陶潜一手指天继续道：
“你看那日头，几时升便升，几时落便落，可曾犹豫过今日该不该亮？”
又往地下一指，“这草木春生夏长，秋枯冬藏，可曾纠结过该不该发芽？”
范蠡一愣，冥冥之中似有所悟，却又抓不住。
“水往低处流，从不往高处攀；火往上头窜，从不朝下头烧。天地万物各循其道，各安其分，不争不抢，不多不少，这便是无为。”
陶潜收回手，望着范蠡。
“饿了便吃，困了便睡，不违背本心，这便是无为。”
“无为不是什么都不做。是该做什么便做什么，不该做什么便不做什么。顺天时，应地利，合人心，不逆势而为，不强求而取。天地因无为而运转不息，圣人因无为而治天下。”
范蠡浑身一震，豁然开朗，他这师果然没有拜错。
“先生……小子明白了。”
他的声音微微发颤，眼眶泛红，郑重朝陶潜躬身一揖。
不远处，那青牛竖着耳朵偷听了半天，牛眼珠子骨碌碌一转，忽然像是想通了什么天大的道理，兴奋得鼻孔喷出两道白气，四蹄刨地，扭过硕大的牛头冲自家老爷嚷道：
“老爷！老爷！牛爷我也悟了！我也明白无为是什么了！”
老者眉头一挑。
青牛清了清嗓子，昂首挺胸，一脸得意，声如洪钟：
“该拉屎时就拉屎！该撒尿时就撒尿！不憋不忍，顺其自然！拉屎撒尿，便是无为大道！”
说完还得意洋洋地甩了甩尾巴，牛脸上的表情分明写着五个大字，夸我快夸我。
老者面色不变，缓缓从袖中伸出手来。
青牛脸色一变：“老爷我说错了吗？”

砰！砰！砰！砰！砰！
五拳如雨点般落下，拳拳砸在牛脑门上！
“老爷饶命！”青牛惨叫着满街乱窜。
老者收回拳头拢入袖中，面色如常，淡淡道：
“再敢把大道与屎尿混为一谈，明日便将你卖去犁田。”
青牛当即老实了，夹着尾巴缩到墙根底下，再不敢吭一声。
老者的目光稳稳落在陶潜身上，眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的赞赏，此人虽然是个鬼仙，却对他道家思想颇有见解，难能可贵。
他本欲前往楚地传授捭阖之道，以期化解即将到来的战国兵戈之劫。如今在这边陲小城遇到这么个有趣的鬼仙，他反倒不急着赶路了。
老者收敛了全身气息，连同那头刚刚挨了揍的青牛一起，隐匿于市井喧嚣之中。
另一边，陶潜领着新收的记名弟子范蠡，在韶关城里转悠了大半个时辰，最后钻进了一条偏僻的巷子，寻了一家门板都快掉下来的破落客栈。
两人刚踏进门槛，那掌柜便伸出枯瘦的手，毫不客气地讨要房钱。
陶潜摸遍了全身上下，好不容易从破烂道袍的夹缝里抠出几枚沾满陈年泥垢的半两钱。他本是穿越而来，在深山老林里修了一百年的道，哪里有攒钱的习惯？
content_en:
Fan Li's mouth twitched and he thought to himself: This old man is really farting. Isn’t it nonsense to eat when you are hungry but not hungry, and to sleep when you are sleepy but not sleepy? A truth that even a three-year-old knows, is it worth explaining?
He was about to retort when he saw Tao Qian pointing his finger to the sky and continuing:
"Look at the sun. It rises whenever it rises and sets whenever it sets. Have you ever hesitated whether it should be bright today?"
Then he pointed to the ground and said, "These plants grow in spring and grow in summer, but wither in autumn and hide in winter. Have you ever wondered whether they should sprout?"
Fan Li was stunned for a moment, as if he had some realization, but he couldn't grasp it.
"Water flows downwards and never climbs upwards; fire flows upwards and never burns downwards. Everything in the world follows its own path, each is in its place, neither fighting nor grabbing, neither more nor less. This is inaction."
Tao Qian took back his hand and looked at Fan Li.
"Eat when you are hungry, sleep when you are sleepy, and do not violate your original intention. This is inaction."
"Wuwei does not mean doing nothing. It means doing what you should do, and not doing what you should not do. When you follow the heavens, you should be in harmony with the earth, and you should be in line with people's hearts. You don't go against the trend, and you don't force things. The heaven and the earth are constantly moving because of inaction, and the saints rule the world because of inaction."
Fan Li was shocked and suddenly realized that his master was indeed right.
"Sir... I understand, boy."
His voice trembled slightly, his eyes were red, and he bowed solemnly to Tao Qian.
Not far away, the green bull eavesdropped for a long time with its ears pricked up. The bull's eyes rolled around, and suddenly he seemed to have figured out some great truth. He was so excited that he blew out two streams of white air from his nostrils, dug his hooves on the ground, turned his huge bull head and shouted at his master:
"Master! Master! Master Niu, I have also realized it! I also understand what Wuwei is!"
The old man raised his eyebrows.
Qingniu cleared his throat, held his head high, looked proud, and said in a loud voice:
"Poop when it's time to poop! Pee when it's time to pee! Don't hold it in, let nature take its course! Shit and pee is the path to inaction!"
After saying that, he swung his tail triumphantly, and the expression on the cow's face clearly read five big words, "Praise me, praise me quickly."
The old man's expression remained unchanged, and he slowly stretched out his hand from his sleeve.
Qingniu's expression changed: "Master, did I say something wrong?"
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
Five punches fell like raindrops, hitting the cow on the head!
"Sir, spare my life!" Qingniu screamed and ran around in the street.
The old man retracted his fist and put it into his sleeve, his face remained as usual, and he said calmly:
"If you dare to confuse the road with shit and urine again, I will sell you to plow the fields tomorrow."
Qingniu immediately became obedient and huddled under the wall with his tail between his legs, not daring to say a word again.
The old man's eyes fell steadily on Tao Qian, and a hint of imperceptible admiration flashed in his eyes. Although this man was a ghost, he had valuable insights into his Taoist thoughts.
He originally wanted to go to the Chu region to teach the art of war, in order to resolve the upcoming war disaster of the Warring States Period. Now that he met such an interesting ghost fairy in this small border town, he was not in a hurry to leave.
The old man restrained his aura, and together with the green bull that had just been beaten, he hid in the hustle and bustle of the market.
On the other side, Tao Qian led his newly acquired disciple Fan Li and wandered around Shaoguan City for more than half an hour. Finally, he got into a remote alley and found a run-down inn with a door panel that was almost falling off.
As soon as the two of them stepped across the threshold, the shopkeeper stretched out his skinny hand and unceremoniously asked for the rent.
Tao Qian felt all over his body and finally dug out a few half-taels of coins covered in old dirt from the cracks in his tattered robe. He originally traveled through time and practiced Taoism in the deep mountains and forests for a hundred years. How could he have the habit of saving money?
